description: Browse the $0.001 primitive catalog. Create a purchase intent and pay only when /market.primitive_entry.paid_execution_enabled is true; otherwise paid execution is unavailable. Prepare a machine-payable x402 request. Check whether an observed state materially differs from an expected state. Compare expected versus actual system state for exact text equality or explicit boolean and configuration polarity mismatch, such as enabled versus disabled. Binary 0/1 when decidable; abstains before billing otherwise. Current deterministic scope: exact normalized text equality returns 0; true/false, yes/no, enabled/disabled, present/absent, required/not required and allowed/not allowed return 1. Other inputs abstain before billing. This is not general language interpretation, diagnosis or a similarity score.
name: prepare_state_deviation_purchase
